runs.t: Salma and Felix are going on a trip to the jungle. They packed their duffle bags and got on a plane to Brazil. Once in Brazil, they rode a shuttle to
the jungle. In the jungle, there was an anaconda by a hill and a sloth that dangled from a vine.

At the end of their trip, they even got to see a huge black cat. Salma and Felix were thrilled as the cats like to hide, so not many people get to see them. “I am so happy we got to see them in the wild,” said Salma. “Same!” said Felix.
